rendered: EG's hydrogen-bonding parameter δh is 26.0[1] MPa^1/2, and PVDF's δh is 9.2[2] MPa^1/2. So EG's δh is larger than PVDF's by 16.8[3] MPa^1/2. For Ra, NMP's value is 2.3[4] MPa^1/2 and EG's value is 16.9[5] MPa^1/2, so EG's Ra is about 7.3[6] times NMP's Ra.
